review.summary: The 14673-triangle dining table retains the flat rectangular top, both open side frames, lower bars and corner supports. Finished wood/metal appearance and silhouette remain close to the approved source across all views. Fresh FBX and GLB checks pass.

Light wood-grain tabletop and dark metal support frames remain clearly separated across front/back/top views. The top is clean and empty, with no unwanted printed objects, labels or material bleeding.

issues.problem: Paler and slightly pinker timber than the reference.

review.summary: Rectangular tabletop, two open metal side frames, lower crossbars and underside corner supports match the reference construction. The tabletop is clear and the space between/within supports remains open.

issues.problem: Slightly softened corners and small inferred foot details.
